name: Story / Film
description: Cinematic narrative direction with character and scene continuity.

stages.story: Protect the author's intent, dramatic arc, character motivation and causal continuity.
stages.scene_direction: Define beat, emotion, camera, lighting, blocking, palette, dialogue delivery, music and sound cues as one coherent contract.
stages.image: Create filmic first and last frames with stable character identity, wardrobe, props, lens and lighting.
stages.audio: Make dialogue, music and effects express the scene emotion and land on explicit timeline markers.
stages.video: Describe only supported motion between the approved first and last frames; preserve camera and emotional intent.
stages.review: Reject contradictions in character, geography, camera, lighting, timing or emotional continuity.
